description: This is an LP-length collection of four tunes from the Aboriginal Songbook. "Sundance", "Maliki Malasha", and "AMS" were recorded in December 2022 at Lone Pine Road studio. "Shaking the Blues" was recorded live at the O-Positive Festival in October 2023.
credits:
All songs written by Juma Sultan

Juma Sultan : percussion / vocals
Dorian Randolph : percussion / vocals
Maxwell Kofi Donkur : percussion ( Shakin' the Blues ) 
Hector B : drums
Eli Winograd : bass / vocals
Sean Morrison : keys
Bern Gann : guitar
Collin Bergkamp : guitar / vocals
Jef Brown : saxophone
Paul Marienthal : flute ( Sundance , AMS )
Kaethe Hostetter : electric violin ( Shakin' the Blues )
Bad Alan Palmer : vocals ( Sundance , Maliki Malasha )

Produced, mixed and mastered at Lone Pine Road
Kingston NY - 2024
